nodes.label: Archify Findings Review & Remediation Report (2026-11-26)
nodes.rationale: Documents source-backed triage of 18 Archify code-analysis findings on main (commit 58247eb) and Option A 3-wave remediation on phase/archify-remediation achieving verdict none-found with 0 open findings and 7 intentional baseline acceptances.

nodes.label: Core-Web Dependency Inversion & skillMatches Unification
nodes.rationale: Moves skillMatches into src/core/filter.ts (preserving no-backtick/no-regex toString() embeddability) and inverts src/core/api.ts -> src/web/page.ts via ApiOptions.pageRenderer with lazy import in src/main.ts to break cycle COUP-e41598564701, eliminate duplicated TUI filter logic, and cut src/web reach from 71% to 29%.

nodes.label: Complexity Hotspot Decomposition (Wave 2)
nodes.source_location: #### 2.4.2. Workstream 2 — Decompose the 5 Production Complexity Hotspots
nodes.rationale: Splits six high-complexity functions (onKey CC 190, update CC 90, route CC 85, SearchBody CC 77, InstalledBody CC 51, budget.ts main CC 46) into focused helpers, typed dispatch tables (ACTION_HANDLERS and HTTP routes), and shared useSelectionScrollFollow hook while preserving race tokens, S-183 memoization, and zero-dash runtime strings.

nodes.label: Byte-Identical Web Page Modularization (Wave 3)
nodes.rationale: Splits 2,713-LOC src/web/page.ts into plain TS template-string modules (styles.ts, client/core.ts, client/installed.ts, client/search-and-boot.ts) to preserve single-binary bun compile self-containment, CSP SHA-256 hash parity, and 0-byte docs/app.html diff while replacing fragile raw-text slicing in dash-sweep.test.ts.

nodes.label: Archify Intentional Baseline Signals & Public Entry Config
nodes.source_location: #### 2.4.5. Workstream 5 — Baseline Intentional Signals (Do Not Over-Refactor)
nodes.rationale: Declares public sub-entries in Archify config.json (preserving lazy startup in src/main.ts and avoiding file-level cycles) and baselines 7 intentional signals (src/core shared kernel, 3 genuine src/web entrypoints, linear HTTP security gate handler, untrusted-JSON guards in disk-index.ts, and shallow parsers in hooks.ts/updates-check.ts) rather than churning clean auditable code.
